requirement_paraphrase: Protocol random draws have a separate named/versioned domain keyed by seed, stable equipment identity, purpose, episode and draw index.
input_precondition: A station makes a protocol random draw.
expected_behavior: Keep the effective seed and draw ledger; do not reuse W1 frozen Purpose 1-16 or one global random cursor.
observable_evidence: Worker/batch permutation and added-station draw-history comparisons.

applicability: An A1 station attempts startup or builds a report.
section: A0 integration contract: EPFS and clock authority
requirement_paraphrase: W1 own truth, EPFS fix validity and station clock validity are distinct explicit inputs with provenance and freshness.
input_precondition: An A1 station attempts startup or builds a report.
expected_behavior: A pilot may declare valid independent direct UTC and own-truth-to-EPFS input; absence never silently creates UTC lock, heading, ROT, PA or RAIM.
observable_evidence: Missing/stale/invalid inputs and explicit pilot-assumption records.

applicability: A local TX decision is handed to RF1 or a decoded frame is rendered.
section: A0 integration contract: immutable message and frame identities
requirement_paraphrase: AIS data, on-air framed bits and receiver NMEA output have separate immutable identities and validity rules.
input_precondition: A local TX decision is handed to RF1 or a decoded frame is rendered.
expected_behavior: Carry payload bit length, framing-version/FCS/bit-stuff plan and exact physical interval; use decoded-frame identity for later NMEA and never armoring fill bits as RF data.
observable_evidence: Independent bit/FCS/frame/NMEA oracles with corrupted-frame negatives.

applicability: A run is recorded or replayed after live equipment state changes.
section: A0 integration contract: durable catalog and replay
requirement_paraphrase: Persist versioned station/equipment/radio/receiver ownership and power history; replay refers to simulation-time reception validity.
input_precondition: A run is recorded or replayed after live equipment state changes.
expected_behavior: Playback a previously valid decode using its original simulation-time evidence; never reject it because current wall-time equipment is OFF.
observable_evidence: Catalog-version replay fixture, including recorded valid receive followed by later OFF.

applicability: A runtime batch/horizon is advanced.
requirement_paraphrase: Future TX decisions are generated only up to causal boundaries supported by available local feedback, independent of RF batching.
input_precondition: A runtime batch/horizon is advanced.
expected_behavior: Stop at relevant observation, clock, power, navigation, reservation or timer boundaries; reject late feedback behind committed event watermark; never precompute five-hour allocations.
observable_evidence: Batch-size permutation with identical committed semantic trace and rejected retroactive feedback.

applicability: Preparing RF1 physical work.
section: A0 integration contract: geometry and decode authority
requirement_paraphrase: RF1 uses explicit valid ellipsoid geometry and complete simulation-time TX/RX power intervals; W1 reach radius is an environment input, never a decode oracle.
input_precondition: Preparing RF1 physical work.
expected_behavior: Reject unresolved AMSL/ellipsoid conversion; retain per-receiver physical outcomes and forbid synthetic ReceptionSuccess from radius or positions alone.
observable_evidence: Invalid-datum and partial-power negative RF fixtures; asymmetric per-receiver results.

applicability: A1/RF1/I1/P1 readiness or acceptance is claimed.
requirement_paraphrase: A pilot declares every deferred Class A capability and its duration/topology limits; deferred obligations are never called normative full conformance.
input_precondition: A1/RF1/I1/P1 readiness or acceptance is claimed.
expected_behavior: Keep first Message3 blocking for any startup; keep Message5 and applicable24B deadlines blocking for a sustained pilot; gate base/poll/assignment/satellite/safety support separately.
observable_evidence: Capability manifest, explicit unsupported stimulus result and independent milestone GO/NO-GO checklist.
